name: Ripped Missive

angles.text: The letter brings bitter news: druids at the den were slaughtered because they stood in the way of cultists seeking a pylon.

faq.answer: The missive is a torn, bloodstained letter found behind Haalien's bracer after a battle. It reveals why cultists attacked a druid den in Shadowgale Forest.

aliases: where did ripped missive come from
faq.answer: The missive was found behind Haalien's bracer after a violent confrontation. The battle left the letter torn and bloodstained.
faq.q: Where is the missive recovered from?

aliases: who do i give ripped missive to
faq.answer: Elegael Thornpaw in Shadowgale Forest should receive the missive first. After reading it, Elegael directs that it be carried swiftly to Lotheluum in Valanaar.
faq.q: Who should receive the Ripped Missive?

aliases: why did cultists attack the druid den
faq.answer: The cultists attacked the druid den to secure a pylon there. They killed the druids because they stood in the way.
faq.q: Why did the cultists attack the druid den?

aliases: where did the orders come from
faq.answer: The missive points to orders from Valanaar, where a traitor may be directing the cultists' work.
faq.q: Where did the attack orders originate?

faq.answer: Lotheluum is a contact in Valanaar. Elegael Thornpaw orders the missive delivered there to warn that the deadly orders trace back to someone hidden in the settlement.
faq.q: Who is Lotheluum and why must they be notified?

sections.body: Haalien's missive gives a glimpse of the violence in Shadowgale Forest. Found after a fierce skirmish, the torn scrap bears grim news of cultists who attacked a local druid den. Its words offer clues to those seeking justice for the fallen.
sections.title: Bloodstained Orders

sections.body: Elegael Thornpaw learns why the cultists struck the den. They sought a mysterious pylon, not a feud with the druids. The den's inhabitants died because they stood in the way. Enraged by the slaughter, Elegael vows vengeance on any cultists still in the forest.
sections.title: Senseless Slaughter

sections.body: Orders from within Valanaar lie behind the attack. The missive points to a directive from the settlement, where a traitor may be at work. To uncover the conspiracy before more lives are lost, the letter must reach Lotheluum in Valanaar without delay.
sections.title: Treachery in Valanaar

summary: Haalien bears a bloodied letter after an attack on a druid den in Shadowgale Forest. Its words reveal what the cultists sought and point toward danger within Valanaar.
